name: Regimental Doctrine
summary: Doctrine Benefit Shock Trooper Once per turn, when you hit with a lasgun, autogun, shotgun, or bolter, deal +1d6 damage. Marksman If you did not move this turn, your first ranged attack gains +2 to hit. Sergeant Allies within 30 ft who can hear you gain +1 to initiative and fear saves.
